_comment: Cross-language deepMerge contract for config.yaml overlay. Semantics: null/undefined source value = 'unset' (keep target); two plain objects recurse; arrays and scalars REPLACE wholesale; object-vs-scalar mismatch replaces. deepMerge(target, source) => expected. Both configService.ts (TS) and config.go (Go) must produce expected for every case.
THE BLOCK REGISTRY. Every array-of-objects block in this file must be declared
here and everything here must be a block — closure in both directions, so a new
block is a failure until someone says what its cases must carry, and a renamed
one cannot quietly stop being validated.
kind of validation existed for exactly ONE block of ONE fixture.

cases.why: deepMerge(target, source) — both copies must fold identically.

cases.name: null source is unset (keeps target default)
nested null unset alongside a nested override
